references.text: God commanded Moses that the Levites should receive cities to live in from the inheritance of the other tribes, which is fulfilled here in Joshua 21.
Eleazar is mentioned as priest and leader over the heads of the Levites, the same role he has in Joshua 21:1.
Eleazar the priest and Joshua, son of Nun, were appointed to divide the land, which they do here with the cities for the Levites.
The same leadership trio is mentioned: Eleazar the priest, Joshua, and the heads of the tribes who distribute the inheritances.
Shows the same pattern where Israelites come before Eleazar, Joshua, and the heads of the tribes to claim their inheritance.
Summarizes that Eleazar, Joshua, and the heads divided the land, the same group to whom the Levites turn.
Parallel text listing the cities for the Levites that were assigned to the various Levitical families.
